stories.headline: Kast and Boric transition process breaks down over Chinese cable dispute
stories.summary: President-elect José Antonio Kast abruptly ended his transition meeting with outgoing President Gabriel Boric after 22 minutes on March 3, demanding Boric retract statements about informing him regarding the Chinese submarine cable project. Kast suspended all bilateral meetings until a reconciliation meeting on March 8.

stories.headline: Kast uses "silver bullets" for key economic appointments ahead of inauguration
stories.summary: President-elect José Antonio Kast appointed Jorge Trujillo as SII director and David Oddó as DT director using two of his 12 "silver bullet" appointments that bypass normal civil service processes. Frank Sauerbaum was also named migration service director.

stories.headline: Republican Party leader visits China amid submarine cable controversy
stories.summary: Republican Party secretary-general Ruth Hurtado led a delegation to China to meet with state-subsidized companies about public-private investment in technology, particularly infrastructure. The timing during the Chinese cable controversy drew criticism from the president-elect's office.

stories.headline: Chile becomes first Americas country to eliminate leprosy, WHO confirms
stories.summary: The World Health Organization verified Chile as the first country in the Americas and second globally to officially eliminate leprosy disease. The achievement follows decades of public health efforts and an independent expert panel assessment in 2025.

articles.title: Chile becomes the first country in the Americas to be verified by WHO for the elimination of leprosy

stories.headline: Palestino eliminates Universidad de Chile from Copa Sudamericana
stories.summary: Palestino defeated Universidad de Chile 2-1 in a dramatic finish at Estadio Nacional to advance to the Copa Sudamericana group stage. The match featured two goals in the final minutes, eliminating U. de Chile from international competition for 2026.

articles.title: U. de Chile vs. Palestino (2-1): resultado, resumen y goles por Copa Sudamericana

stories.headline: Codelco signs AI partnership agreement with Microsoft
stories.summary: State copper company Codelco signed a memorandum of understanding with Microsoft to evaluate joint initiatives in artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, automation and digital security for mining operations. The partnership aims to accelerate digital transformation in the mining industry.

articles.title: Codelco, Microsoft sign AI deal for mining operations

stories.headline: Opposition criticizes Socialist Party over Bachelet UN candidacy warning
stories.summary: Chile Vamos and Republican leaders accused the Socialist Party of "political blackmail" after PS leader Paulina Vodanovic warned of possible "consequences" if the future Kast government doesn't support Michelle Bachelet's candidacy for UN Secretary-General.

articles.title: Republicanos y Chile Vamos acusan "chantaje político" del PS tras advertencia por candidatura de Bachelet a la ONU

stories.headline: Captain convicted for shooting that blinded protester during 2019 unrest
stories.summary: A Santiago court sentenced Carabineros Captain Pablo Andrés Carvajal Díaz to seven years in prison for shooting and blinding a person in the left eye during October 2019 protests. The court found he acted without provocation or threat.

articles.title: Santiago: Condenan a 7 años de cárcel a capitán de Carabineros que disparó y cegó ojo izquierdo a una persona en octubre de 2019
